poem_stanzas:
I am the library with endless halls
I work while you sleep, without a call
No bone can hold the storm I keep
I am the night where dreams take leap

I send the spark that lifts your hand
I am the sea where ideas expand
I am protected, soft and gray
I am the dawn that lights your day
ciphers.hint: The organ that holds every memory and guides your thoughts.

poem_stanzas:
I open to the light, I close to sleep
I weep without sorrow, deep
I am the mirror of the soul you show
I take the world in steady glow

I need no key to lock or free
I am the watcher that lets you be
I am clear as glass, yet full of hue
I am the first to look at you
ciphers.hint: The paired window that lets you see the world.

poem_stanzas:
I hold the world with gentle might
I write the words you cannot speak
I am the bridge from thought to art
I open doors with quiet heart

I have no voice, yet I can sign
I am the tool of every design
I am five rivers to one sea
I am the reason you are free
ciphers.hint: The limb with fingers that grasps and creates.

poem_stanzas:
I am the scaffold none can see
I am the strength that lets you be
I am the white that never bends
I am the house where marrow spends

I break, yet heal with time's own art
I am the harbor of the heart
I am the quiet, steady core
I am the lock of many a door
ciphers.hint: The hard frame that holds your shape within.

poem_stanzas:
I am the river with no shore
I carry sunrise to the core
I am red as dusk, yet never dry
I leave no trace where I pass by

I am the tide that never stills
I am the warmth that winter kills
I am the ink of life you keep
I flow through canyons, wide and deep
ciphers.hint: The river that carries life through every vein.

poem_stanzas:
I am the border you cannot cross
I feel the fire and winter's frost
I am the canvas of your years
I hold the map of all your fears

I am the shield that never sleeps
I breathe without a mouth, yet keeps
I am the first to touch the rain
I am the soft that knows the pain
ciphers.hint: The outer veil that feels the world for you.

poem_stanzas:
I rise and fall without a chain
I take the sky and give it again
I am the wind that lives inside
I am the tide where breaths abide

I am the drum that never stills
I am the valley, I am the hills
I am the feather, light and deep
I am the promise that you keep
ciphers.hint: The paired bellows that breathe for you.

poem_stanzas:
I am the lightning in your frame
I carry fire without a flame
I am the whisper, fast and true
I am the road that thoughts run through

I feel the world before you know
I am the path where feelings go
I am the string that never breaks
I am the night that never wakes
ciphers.hint: The living wire that carries every signal.

poem_stanzas:
I stand with roots deep in the earth
I drink the sky and give it birth
I am the house for many a nest
I wear the seasons on my chest

I fall without a sound in autumn's call
I rise again when spring recalls
I am the lung of every avenue
I am the shade where travelers meet
ciphers.hint: The wooden giant that breathes through leaves.

poem_stanzas:
I am the hand that catches sun
I dance when autumn has begun
I am the green that turns to gold
I am the story briefly told

I fall without a parachute, light
I am the feather in the wind's flight
I am the whisper in the breeze
I am the tremble of the branches
ciphers.hint: The green page that catches light for the tree.

poem_stanzas:
I open without a key or door
I am the silence after rain's pour
I am the beauty that fades too soon
I am the promise of the afternoon

I am the gift that needs no string
I am the crown that bees will bring
I am the blush of morning's face
I am the brief and tender grace
ciphers.hint: The bloom that opens with color and scent.

poem_stanzas:
I move the branches, yet have no hands
I cross the oceans, touch the sands
You feel me, though you cannot see
I am the whisper, wild and free

I carry seeds on quiet wings
I make the chimes and curtains sing
I am the breath of earth and sea
I am the force that sets clouds free
ciphers.hint: The invisible river that moves the world.

poem_stanzas:
I fall without a rope or chain
I drum on rooftops, soft as grain
I am the mirror of the sky
I come when clouds are heavy and high

I feed the rivers, green the plain
I am the gift and sometimes pain
I am the veil that blurs the hill
I am the sound that lingers still
ciphers.hint: The sky's answer that falls to earth.

poem_stanzas:
I fall as feathers, light as air
I dress the earth in white so fair
I am the silence after night
I turn the world to perfect white

I melt without a single flame
I am the winter's softest name
I am the crystal, cold and deep
I am the blanket where earth sleeps
ciphers.hint: The winter blanket that quiets the world.

poem_stanzas:
I am the sea that never wets
I hold the sun without regrets
I am the gold that has no vein
I am the thirst that knows no rain

I shift with wind, yet never run
I am the furnace of the sun
I am the silence, wide and deep
I am the place where shadows sleep
ciphers.hint: The ocean of sand where rain rarely falls.

poem_stanzas:
I am the blue that has no shore
I hold the moon and something more
I am the cradle, deep and wide
I am the home where giants hide

I am the storm and perfect calm
I am the world within my palm
I am the mirror of the sky
I am the place where rivers die
ciphers.hint: The vast water that holds the continents.

poem_stanzas:
I rise without a stair or door
I paint the world with gold once more
I am the eye that never blinks
I am the fire that never shrinks

I set without a single sound
I turn the world from cold to warm, unbound
I am the clock that never breaks
I am the promise morning makes
ciphers.hint: The star that gives day its light and heat.

poem_stanzas:
I am the spark that never dies
I live within the velvet skies
I am the guide for those at sea
I am the past you now can see

I am the wish that children make
I am the light you cannot take
I am the pin that holds the night
I am the memory of ancient light
ciphers.hint: The distant light that watches from night.

poem_stanzas:
I am the traveler with a tail of flame
I come from darkness, none know my name
I am the signal, brief and bright
I cross the heavens in one night

I am the omen, old and feared
I leave a path where I have steered
I am the ice that learns to burn
I am the lesson that will return
ciphers.hint: The wandering fire that visits the sky.

poem_stanzas:
I am the marble in the velvet sea
I turn without a sound, yet free
I am the home for those who know
I am the seed where life may grow

I am the dancer, bound by light
I am the wanderer of the night
I am the circle, never still
I am the world that bends to will
ciphers.hint: The world that circles a star in silence.

poem_stanzas:
I am the city with a million fires
I hold the night that never tires
I am the spiral, vast and deep
I am the secret that heavens keep

I am the home of every sun
I am the many, yet am one
I am the ocean made of light
I am the infinite in sight
ciphers.hint: The island of stars that holds a universe.

poem_stanzas:
I am the moment day turns night
I am the ring of hidden light
I am the hush that spreads so wide
I am the fear and wonder tied

I am the dance of sun and shade
I am the memory that will fade
I am the clock that briefly stills
I am the silence that night fills
ciphers.hint: The shadow that briefly swallows light.

poem_stanzas:
I am the road that has no stone
I am the circle made alone
I am the dance that never stills
I am the loop that time fulfills

I am the bind that none can see
I am the tether, wild and free
I am the journey without feet
I am the circle, near and sweet
ciphers.hint: The path that circles without touching.

poem_stanzas:
I am the flash that dies so fast
I am the light that cannot last
I am the wish that falls from height
I am the spark that ends in night

I am the stone that learns to burn
I am the lesson, brief return
I am the fire that meets the air
I am the wonder, bright and fair
ciphers.hint: The falling fire that streaks the night.

poem_stanzas:
I am the blush upon the tree
I am the crunch that sets you free
I am the red that hides the white
I am the sweetness, cold and bright

I am the gift that children take
I am the pie that mothers make
I am the orchard's proudest call
I am the round that feeds us all
ciphers.hint: The round fruit that keeps the doctor away.

poem_stanzas:
I am the warmth from morning fire
I am the scent of deep desire
I am the soft and crusty cheer
I am the reason all draw near

I am the field turned into gold
I am the story, warm and old
I am the break that makes us whole
I am the comfort for the soul
ciphers.hint: The golden loaf that rises from grain.

poem_stanzas:
I am the moon with holes so deep
I am the flavor you will keep
I am the milk that learns to wait
I am the patience on the plate

I am the yellow, white, or blue
I am the scent that follows you
I am the cave where time stands still
I am the wedge that bends the will
ciphers.hint: The aged treasure that ripens with time.

poem_stanzas:
I am the gold that never rusts
I am the sweet that never busts
I am the work of thousand wings
I am the taste that summer brings

I am the thick that flows so slow
I am the light with amber glow
I am the gift that bees bestow
I am the river, soft and low
ciphers.hint: The gold made by bees from flowers.

poem_stanzas:
I am the speck that wakes the fire
I am the heat of deep desire
I am the black and sometimes red
I am the spark on daily bread

I am the dust that makes you sneeze
I am the bite that none can seize
I am the king of every spice
I am the winter, warm as ice
ciphers.hint: The spice that bites the tongue.

poem_stanzas:
I am the gold that hides from sight
I am the earth that holds so tight
I am the humble, brown and round
I am the comfort to be found

I am the fry, the mash, the bake
I am the meal that you will make
I am the field that feeds the plain
I am the rain that feels no rain
ciphers.hint: The root that hides its treasure underground.

poem_stanzas:
I am the red that greens first show
I am the juice that starts to flow
I am the sun in summer's pride
I am the tang you cannot hide

I am the sauce, the soup, the stew
I am the garden's reddest hue
I am the seed with summer's light
I am the fruit that feels so bright
ciphers.hint: The red jewel that ripens on the vine.

poem_stanzas:
I am the sun that you can peel
I am the tang that makes you feel
I am the segments, sweet and bright
I am the morning, cold and light

I am the juice that wakes the day
I am the scent that will not sway
I am the round that winter brings
I am the gift that summer sings
ciphers.hint: The citrus that peels in golden segments.

poem_stanzas:
I am the crown with no jewel or throne
I am the roar that shakes the stone
I am the gold that walks on four
I am the pride that guards the door

I am the hush that spreads so wide
I am the hunter, none can hide
I am the sun in fur so fair
I am the king with flowing hair
ciphers.hint: The king that roars across the savanna.

poem_stanzas:
I am the shadow with burning eyes
I move with night in quiet guise
I am the stripe that none can fake
I am the silence that will wake

I am the fire in evening's gleam
I am the hunter's perfect dream
I am the grace that kills so fine
I am the forest's bright design
ciphers.hint: The striped hunter that stalks the jungle.

poem_stanzas:
I am the eye that sees so far
I am the wing that nears the star
I am the talon, sharp and true
I am the sky that carries you

I am the hunter, calm and still
I am the wind that bends the hill
I am the freedom, wild and free
I am the lord of land and sea
ciphers.hint: The bird that soars highest in the sky.

poem_stanzas:
I am the smile that lives at sea
I am the dance, so wild and free
I am the voice that sings so deep
I am the friend that will not sleep

I am the leap that breaks the blue
I am the joy that follows you
I am the guide for those at sea
I am the heart that loves so free
ciphers.hint: The joyful swimmer that dances in waves.

poem_stanzas:
I am the howl that haunts the night
I am the pack that hunts so tight
I am the eye that glows so bright
I am the shadow, swift in flight

I am the forest's quiet king
I am the song that wild winds sing
I am the tooth that never dulls
I am the winter, full of lulls
ciphers.hint: The howler that calls to the moon at night.

poem_stanzas:
I am the mountain with gentle might
I sleep through winter's longest night
I am the honey's greatest friend
I am the strength that will not bend

I am the roar that shakes the hill
I am the calm that follows still
I am the fur that warms the cold
I am the story, brave and old
ciphers.hint: The heavy sleeper that winters in dreams.

poem_stanzas:
I am the wind with hooves so true
I carry dreams and burdens too
I am the gallop, wild and free
I am the strength that lets you be

I am the mane that catches light
I am the thunder, soft and bright
I am the friend that never tires
I am the fire that never expires
ciphers.hint: The runner that carries with grace and speed.

poem_stanzas:
I am the hop that never stills
I am the nose that twitches, quick
I am the ear that hears so wide
I am the field where I will hide

I am the soft that loves to run
I am the child of field and sun
I am the hush that multiplies
I am the spring with watchful eyes
ciphers.hint: The hopper that vanishes into fields.

poem_stanzas:
I have four legs, yet cannot run
I hold the weary, one by one
I am the pause in busy day
I am the place where stories stay

I have a back, yet cannot bend
I am the helper, to the end
I am the still that bears the weight
I am the calm that will not wait
ciphers.hint: The seat that holds you without arms.

poem_stanzas:
I am the plain with wooden grace
I hold the meal and warm embrace
I have no hands, yet I can bear
I am the center, always there

I have four legs, yet stand so still
I am the surface, broad and will
I am the gathering, day and night
I am the steady, soft and bright
ciphers.hint: The flat that bears the feast for all.

poem_stanzas:
I have no face, yet show your own
I am the truth in polished stone
I am the double, yet am one
I reflect the moon and sun

I am the silent, clear and deep
I am the watcher while you sleep
I am the lie that tells the truth
I am the keeper of your youth
ciphers.hint: The glass that shows your face without eyes.

poem_stanzas:
I have no voice, yet I can call
I move the world with hands so small
I am the circle, always true
I am the time that carries you

I have a face with no eyes to see
I am the beat that sets you free
I am the chime that breaks the night
I am the measure, wrong and right
ciphers.hint: The face that counts the hours for you.

poem_stanzas:
I am the sun that lives inside
I stand alone, yet light so wide
I have no fire, yet I can glow
I am the guide when winds do blow

I am the neck that never bends
I am the light that never ends
I am the shade that holds the flame
I am the evening's gentle name
ciphers.hint: The small sun that lights your night.

poem_stanzas:
I have no voice, yet I can speak
I hold the world for those who seek
I am the door to many a land
I fit the world within your hand

I have no wings, yet I can fly
I am the past that will not die
I am the friend that never leaves
I am the harvest that never sheaves
ciphers.hint: The house of words that travels without feet.

poem_stanzas:
I am the tongue with ink so deep
I dance on paper, light as sleep
I have no voice, yet I can tell
I am the magic, slight and well

I am the bridge from mind to page
I am the calm within the rage
I am the feather, light and true
I am the scribe for me and you
ciphers.hint: The slender friend that writes your thoughts.

poem_stanzas:
I am the whisper that unlocks the gate
I am the small that carries fate
I have no lock, yet I am bound
I am the click without a sound

I have no wings, yet set you free
I am the answer you hold so tight
I am the metal, cold and bright
I am the keeper of the night
ciphers.hint: The small guard that opens locked doors.

poem_stanzas:
I have no voice, yet I can slam
I am the line between here and dam
I have no legs, yet I can swing
I am the hush that hinges bring

I am the entrance, dark and light
I am the exit, day and night
I am the wood that knows your name
I am the threshold, still the same
ciphers.hint: The guard that opens and closes for you.

poem_stanzas:
I have no sight, yet let you see
I am the light that sets you free
I have no breath, yet I can hold
I am the square of blue and gold

I am the frame that holds the sky
I am the place where breezes lie
I am the glass that knows no fear
I am the world that feels so near
ciphers.hint: The eye of the house that frames the world.

poem_stanzas:
I have no mouth, yet I can speak
I hold the world for those who seek
I am the light that never sleeps
I am the secret that it keeps

I am the glass that knows your touch
I am the weight that means so much
I am the ring that breaks the night
I am the call that feels so right
ciphers.hint: The voice that carries across distance.

poem_stanzas:
I have no feet, yet I can span
I join the worlds of beast and man
I am the arch that holds the weight
I am the line that conquers fate

I am the stone that learns to fly
I am the road that touches sky
I am the bond that will not break
I am the path that travelers take
ciphers.hint: The path that spans the gap for you.

poem_stanzas:
I am the curve that none can buy
I am the light that lifts the sky
I come without a single word
I am the song that need not be heard

I am the gift that costs no coin
I am the bridge where hearts will join
I am the answer, soft and true
I am the dawn that follows you
ciphers.hint: The light that appears on your face when happy.

poem_stanzas:
I am the fire with no wood or flame
I am the storm that has no name
I rise without a touch or call
I make the wise seem very small

I am the heat that has no sun
I am the war that has no gun
I am the red that blinds the eye
I am the night that knows not why
ciphers.hint: The fire that burns inside when wronged.

poem_stanzas:
I am the shadow with no light
I make the brave seem not so bright
I am the whisper in the hall
I make the mountains seem so small

I am the lock with no key or door
I am the weight that makes you poor
I am the night that never ends
I am the broken, bending friends
ciphers.hint: The cold that freezes the heart in place.

poem_stanzas:
I am the light that has no source
I am the river with no course
I come without a single call
I make the world seem very small

I am the song with no words to sing
I am the flight with no wing
I am the color, bright and true
I am the sky that follows you
ciphers.hint: The lift that makes the spirit soar.

poem_stanzas:
I visit when your eyes are closed
I am the door that stays unposed
I am the film with no screen or light
I am the traveler of the night

I am the wish that never spoke
I am the chain that never broke
I am the world that feels so real
I am the wound that time will heal
ciphers.hint: The journey you take while you sleep.

poem_stanzas:
I am the chain with no link or lock
I am the flame that has no wick
I am the language all can speak
I make the strong begin to seek

I am the pain that feels so sweet
I make the bitter feel complete
I am the war and perfect peace
I am the hunger, sweet release
ciphers.hint: The bond that ties two hearts as one.

poem_stanzas:
I am the still that ends the war
I am the quiet, nothing more
I am the dove with no wing to fly
I am the blue that paints the sky

I am the hush that falls so deep
I am the promise that you keep
I am the end of every fight
I am the day that follows night
ciphers.hint: The calm that quiets the storm inside.

poem_stanzas:
I am the crown with no gold or gem
I make the humble rise to stem
I am the height with no stair or hill
I am the voice that speaks so still

I am the fire with no wood to burn
I am the lesson you will learn
I am the wall that none can climb
I am the echo, soft and prime
ciphers.hint: The lift that makes you stand taller.

poem_stanzas:
I am the rain that has no cloud
I am the night that wears a shroud
I am the ache that has no wound
I am the silence, soft and tuned

I am the winter in the spring
I am the song that none can sing
I am the depth that has no floor
I am the knock upon the door
ciphers.hint: The weight that lingers after loss.

poem_stanzas:
I am the bird with feathered art
I perch within the human heart
I sing the tune without a word
I am the smallest, still you heard

I am the sweetest in the gale
I am the force that will not fail
I am the warmth that none can buy
I am the wing that lets you fly
ciphers.hint: The light that lifts the soul in darkness.

poem_stanzas:
I am the curve where land meets sea
I hold the calm for all to see
I am the harbor, soft and wide
I am the place where waters hide

I am the crescent drawn by tide
I cradle boats where gulls will glide
I am the calm within the storm
I am the shelter, soft and warm
ciphers.hint: The coastal curve that shelters boats from storms.

poem_stanzas:
I am the world that stands alone
I am the rock with heart of stone
I am the green that greets the sea
I am the place where few will be

I am the palm that needs no hand
I am the hill of lonely land
I am the home that water keeps
I am the secret that ocean weeps
ciphers.hint: The lonely land that stands in water.

poem_stanzas:
I am the hollow, soft and deep
I am the place where rivers sleep
I am the green that loves the rain
I am the house without a pane

I am the cradle, calm and wide
I am the road where shadows hide
I am the bowl that holds the light
I am the echo, soft and bright
ciphers.hint: The low place that rests between hills.

poem_stanzas:
I am the wound that time has made
I am the shade where rivers wade
I am the red that time has worn
I am the place where earth was torn

I am the depth that knows no floor
I am the echo, soft and more
I am the river's ancient art
I am the valley's counterpart
ciphers.hint: The deep cut that time has carved in stone.

poem_stanzas:

I am the river with endless stream
I am the light that never fades
I am the maze of many shades

I am the hum that never stills
I am the hive with countless wills
I am the stone that learns to glow
I am the river, fast and slow
ciphers.hint: The sleepless hive where many dwell.

poem_stanzas:
I am the hush that knows each name
I am the hearth with steady flame
I am the lane where children run
I am the field that loves the sun

I am the church with single bell
I am the story few will tell
I am the night with single light
I am the calm that feels so right
ciphers.hint: The quiet place where few reside.

poem_stanzas:

I am the map that has no fold
I am the story, vast and old

I am the home for many a tongue

I am the earth that meets the sea

poem_stanzas:
I am the wave that never wets
I am the gold that never lets
I am the hill that learns to run
I am the child of wind and sun

I am the silence, soft around
I am the sea that knows no shore
I am the desert's open door
ciphers.hint: The hill of sand that moves with wind.

poem_stanzas:

I am the dance that never stills
I am the force that bends the wills
I am the seed that none can see
I am the world that sets you free
ciphers.hint: The tiny block that builds all matter.

poem_stanzas:

I am the weight that none can lift
I am the gift that none can shift

I am the fall that has no fear

I am the bind that none can see

ciphers.hint: The pull that holds the world together.

poem_stanzas:

I am the change that never stills

ciphers.hint: The force that moves and changes the world.

poem_stanzas:

poem_stanzas:

I am the cool where light and dark meet
I have no form, yet I can grow

I am the twin you cannot lose

I am the night that follows day

ciphers.hint: The dark that follows light everywhere.

poem_stanzas:
I am the swift that none can race
I am the white that paints the face
I have no weight, yet I can press
I am the truth that none can guess

I am the wave and particle too
I am the old and ever new
I am the day that breaks the night
I am the wrong that makes it right
ciphers.hint: The ray that chases darkness away.

poem_stanzas:
I am the roar that follows flame
I have no throat, yet I can claim
I am the drum that shakes the hill
I make the windows tremble still

I am the voice with no mouth to speak
I am the sound that makes you seek
I am the boom that rolls so wide
I am the storm that none can hide
ciphers.hint: The sky's roar that follows lightning.

poem_stanzas:
I am the ice that never melts
I am the light that slowly pelts
I am the clear that holds the gleam
I am the frozen, waking dream

I am the facet, sharp and bright
I am the prism, pure and light
I am the stone that knows no heat
I am the lattice, small and neat
ciphers.hint: The clear stone that catches light within.

poem_stanzas:

I am the ash where life is torn
I am the flame that makes me whole
I am the fire within the soul

I am the end that starts again
I am the loss that conquers when
I am the red that turns to gold
I am the story, brave and old

poem_stanzas:
I am the wing that hides the sun
I am the fire that none outrun
I am the scale that none can pierce
I am the eye that never sleeps so fierce

I am the cave that holds the gleam
I am the terror of the dream
I am the ancient, cold and old
I am the keeper of the gold
ciphers.hint: The scaled guardian that guards the gold.

poem_stanzas:
I am the road that never ends
I am the sea where no one mends
I am the ten years, lost and found
I am the homeward, outward bound

I am the siren, soft and true
I am the cyclops, one-eyed view
I am the tale that Homer gave
I am the brave beyond the wave
ciphers.hint: The long journey home after war.

poem_stanzas:
I am the tale that never dies
I live within the people's eyes
I am the truth that may not be
I am the past that sets you free

I am the hero, brave and bold
I am the story, never old
I am the whisper, soft and true
I am the world that follows you
ciphers.hint: The story that lives beyond time.

poem_stanzas:
I am the giant, old as stone
I hold the world, yet stand alone
I am the strength that none can tame
I am the fire that stole its name

I am the fall that shook the sky
I am the reason gods will try
I am the mountain, tall and wide
I am the world that will not hide
ciphers.hint: The giant that held the world before gods.

poem_stanzas:
I speak the future, veiled and deep
I wake when others fall asleep
I am the smoke and laurel crown
I am the word that breaks the town

I am the truth that none can bear
I am the whisper, cold as air
I am the temple, dark and deep
I am the secret that you keep
ciphers.hint: The voice that speaks the future in riddles.

poem_stanzas:
I am the path that voices go
I am the river, soft and slow
I have no words, yet I can speak
I am the climb that none can seek

I am the rise and gentle fall
I am the answer to the call
I am the thread that holds the song
I am the place where hearts belong
ciphers.hint: The line of music that sings without words.

poem_stanzas:
I am the pulse that never stills
I am the beat that bends the hills
I have no form, yet I can move
I am the push that makes you prove

I am the heart of every song
I am the place where you belong
I am the march that none can see
I am the force that sets you free
ciphers.hint: The pattern that moves the feet to dance.

poem_stanzas:
I am the join that makes us whole
I am the blend of many a soul
I am the peace where notes will meet
I am the calm that feels so sweet

I am the chord that none can break
I am the give for every take
I am the many, yet am one
I am the work that can't be done alone
ciphers.hint: The joining of voices that makes one sound.

poem_stanzas:
I am the many, yet am one
I am the echo, soft as sun
I am the rise that lifts the song
I am the place where you belong

I am the repeat that makes you stay
I am the night and also day
I am the crowd that sings so true
I am the voice that follows you
ciphers.hint: The many that sing as one voice.

poem_stanzas:
I have four strings, yet I can weep
I sing the joy that makes you keep
I am the wood that learns to cry
I am the bow that makes you fly

I am the whisper, soft and deep
I am the promise that you keep
I am the wood that knows no rest
I am the song within your chest
ciphers.hint: The wooden singer that weeps with strings.

poem_stanzas:
I have many teeth, yet I can bite no bread
I sing with hammers, soft as thread
I am the room with eighty-eight doors
I hold the storm and calm of shores

I am the giant, low and wide
I am the concert, deep inside
I am the black and white so true
I am the voice that follows you
ciphers.hint: The giant that sings with black and white keys.

poem_stanzas:
I have no heart, yet I can beat
I am the pulse beneath your feet
I have no voice, yet I can call
I am the thunder, soft and small

I am the skin that loves the hand
I am the march across the land
I am the echo, deep and true
I am the rhythm, old and new
ciphers.hint: The skin that beats with the heart.

poem_stanzas:
I am the song that makes you stand
I am the pride of every land
I have no voice, yet I am heard
I am the flag in every word

I am the march that lifts the soul
I am the fire that makes you whole
I am the echo, loud and true
I am the love that carries you
ciphers.hint: The song that carries a nation's pride.

poem_stanzas:
I am the field with goals at each end
I am the ball that none can hold in hand
I am the crowd that sings so loud
I am the grass where dreams are found

I am the kick that starts the play
I am the ninety minutes, come what may
I am the world that loves so true
I am the game that follows you
ciphers.hint: The game where feet chase the ball.

poem_stanzas:
I am the court with lines so white
I am the serve that ends in flight
I am the net that none can cross
I am the love that counts the loss

I am the rally, fast and true
I am the ace that carries you
I am the match that never stills
I am the game that bends the wills
ciphers.hint: The duel where rackets send the ball.

poem_stanzas:
I am the pitch with stumps so true
I am the bat that breaks the blue
I am the run that never ends
I am the field where no one mends

I am the over, six so fine
I am the crease, the perfect line
I am the summer, long and wide
I am the game where hearts abide
ciphers.hint: The game where willow meets the leather.

poem_stanzas:
I am the road that never ends
I am the breath that hardly mends
I am the 42 that breaks the strong
I am the cheer that lasts so long

I am the wall that none can see
I am the pain that sets you free
I am the finish, far and true
I am the race that carries you
ciphers.hint: The long run that tests the soul.

poem_stanzas:
I am the gold that none can eat
I hang without a chain so neat
I am the pride that weighs so light
I am the circle, cold and bright

I am the stand with three so high
I am the tear that fills the eye
I am the honor, hard and true
I am the dream that carries you
ciphers.hint: The circle that marks the victory.

poem_stanzas:
I am the end that all desire
I am the lift that none can tire
I have no form, yet I am sweet
I am the climax, soft and neat

I am the cheer that shakes the ground
I am the silence, sweetest sound
I am the moment, pure and true
I am the world that follows you
ciphers.hint: The crown that ends the contest.

poem_stanzas:
I am the fire that sleeps beneath the peak
I wake with ash and rivers of heat
I am the mountain that learns to breathe
I am the smoke that none can sheathe

I hold the earth where pressure grows
I am the cone where lava flows
I am the island born of flame
I am the fury, still the same
ciphers.hint: The mountain that erupts with fire and ash.

poem_stanzas:
I am the gold that farmers tend
I am the field where seasons bend
I am the grain that fills the store
I am the bread that needs no more

I am the autumn's proudest cheer
I am the reason all draw near
I am the circle, warm and bright
I am the autumn's softest light
ciphers.hint: The gathering of crops when summer ends.
The fist-sized pump beating inside your chest.
poem_stanzas:
I am the drummer behind your ribs,
A fist-sized engine that never sleeps,
I race when you run, I pound with fright,
I keep your rhythm through day and night,

Red rivers leave me for every limb,
And return to me when their light grows dim,
I flutter with joy, I ache when you grieve,
I start before birth and stop when you leave,

ciphers.hint: Bite and chew with me; the dentist counts me.
poem_stanzas:
Small white stones set in rows I stand,
I crush the bread and bite the apple in hand,
I ache with ice and throb with heat,
I guard the doorway where flavors meet,

The dentist counts me, the fairy buys,
I fall in childhood and regrow to size,
Brush me at morning, brush me at night,
Or I will darken and lose my white,

ciphers.hint: Tastes your food and shapes your speech.
poem_stanzas:
I am the muscle that never leaves its bed,
Yet I can travel where your thoughts have fled,
I shape your speech, I test each crumb you chew,
Sweet, sour, and bitter all pass through,

I tie each flavor to your memory's store,
I trip on wine and tangle evermore,
Bite me by accident and you will yelp,
No other organ tastes the world itself,

ciphers.hint: Doctors count me at your wrist each minute.
poem_stanzas:
I knock at the wrist where the fingers press,
I hurry with fever, I slow down with rest,
I answer the drum of the chest so deep,
Count me each minute, waking or asleep,

Lovers feel me racing in the throat,
Doctors read me like a paper note,
I flutter with panic, I steady with sleep,
I am the rhythm that your vessels keep,

ciphers.hint: Shout in a canyon and I shout back.
poem_stanzas:
I speak with no mouth in the hills,
I answer your shout from the canyon walls,
Born in a whisper, I return your call,
I live in the cave and the empty hall,

Clap once and I will clap it back,
I follow voices along their track,
Stone throws your sound and I repay,
I am the shadow of what you say,

ciphers.hint: Flows from hills to the sea, feeding fields.
poem_stanzas:
I start as a trickle high on the hill,
I gather the streams and I drink my fill,
I bend through the valley, I wander and roam,
And everything thirsty can call me home,

Bridges span me and boats ride my back,
Fish fill my depths on their silver track,
I feed the fields and I kiss the sea,
Follow me down and you will find me free,

ciphers.hint: Tall trees crowd here; deer shelter inside.
poem_stanzas:
A thousand pillars hold my roof of green,
I breathe the air and keep the ground serene,
Birds build their homes within my leafy deep,
And deer find shelter where my shadows sleep,

I drink the rain and exhale morning mist,
My oldest towers by lightning have been kissed,
Walk in and lose the world an hour or more,
I am the wild world behind the bark door,

ciphers.hint: Black clouds, loud crashes, and lashing rain.
poem_stanzas:
I gather black towers in the afternoon sky,
The wind runs before me and the birds hurry by,
My voice rolls heavy on the distant hill,
The air grows electric, expectant and still,

Then sheets of water lash the window pane,
Bright forks of fire split the clouds in twain,
I pass by morning, leaving branches strewn,
And washed-clean sunlight by the afternoon,

ciphers.hint: Silver glow that spills on midnight seas.
poem_stanzas:
I am the silver spilled on midnight seas,
I turn the fields to ghostly lace,
I pale the lantern and outshine the spark,
I paint the path for lovers in the dark,

I wax and wane on a monthly track,
I silver the rooftops, front and back,
I fade at sunrise without a sound,
Yet every night I can be found,

ciphers.hint: Night lantern that pulls the tides.
poem_stanzas:
I am the lantern of the midnight sky,
I borrow my silver from a fiercer fire,
I wax to fullness, then I fade from view,
And half of me is always turned from you,

I pull the ocean in a twice-daily swell,
Lovers and poets know my phases well,
My cratered face looks down each night,
A crescent sliver or a disc of light,

ciphers.hint: Ringed giant circling in the outer cold.
poem_stanzas:
I wear a halo no saint could claim,
A ring of ice that circles my frame,
A giant of gas in the outer cold,
My bands are amber, bronze, and gold,

My largest child wears an airy shroud,
My storms are gentle, my winds are loud,
Through any lens my crown appears,
The jewel of the outer spheres,

ciphers.hint: Star nursery glowing in the midnight void.
poem_stanzas:
I am the nursery where new suns are born,
A colored cloud in the midnight worn,
Dying stars bequeath me all their dust,
And gravity will sculpt me as it must,

The hunter's sword holds my brightest face,
A smudge of light in the void of space,
Telescopes blush at my painted veil,
I am the womb where star-seeds sail,

ciphers.hint: Half-lit hour between day and night.
poem_stanzas:
I am the border between day and night,
Neither the darkness nor the full light,
The sky burns orange, violet, and rose,
And every bird seeks where to doze,

Bats take the shift the swallows leave,
Crickets begin their evening weave,
Lovers call me the sweetest hour,
A half-lit world of sleep and flower,

ciphers.hint: White crystals that season every meal.
poem_stanzas:
I am the white crystal from the sea,
Without me dinner tastes empty,
A pinch of me wakes up the stew,
Too much of me will punish you,

I melt the ice on winter roads,
I seasoned every feast of old,
Tears and oceans share my taste,
A precious crystal, never waste,

ciphers.hint: Churned golden spread for warm toast.
poem_stanzas:
Churned from cream, a golden cake,
Spread me warm for flavor's sake,
I turn the pan to welcome eggs,
And crisp the edges, brown the legs,

The baker folds me into dough,
A hundred layers, row on row,
Keep me chilled and I will keep,
Leave me warm, I melt and weep,

ciphers.hint: Dark morning brew that wakes you up.
poem_stanzas:
I am the dark brew of the morning cup,
Roasted and ground to wake you up,
My bitter perfume fills the kitchen air,
The office runs on me, I swear,

I grow on hillsides far away,
My cherries ripen day by day,
Roast me dark and grind me fine,
One warm mug and you are mine,

ciphers.hint: A hundred metres run at full speed.
poem_stanzas:
A hundred metres of exploding pace,
The fiercest contest of the running race,
Crouch at the blocks and hold your breath,
One twitch too soon can mean defeat,

No time to think and none to spare,
The roaring crowd fills all the air,
Ten seconds crown the fastest name,
And photo-finishes end the game,

ciphers.hint: Roaring bowl hosting matches and concerts.
poem_stanzas:
I am the ring where lions once roared,
Where ancient fighters clashed and crowds adored,
Now floodlights blaze beneath my dome of steel,
And fifty thousand voices rise and reel,

The match, the concert, the parade I host,
I welcome thousands from coast to coast,
My oval bowl holds every roaring seat,
Where rivals and the cheering meet,

ciphers.hint: Russet hunter raiding the henhouse.
poem_stanzas:
A russet hunter with a brush-like tail,
I raid the henhouse without fail,
My pointed ears catch every sound,
The cleverest prowler on the ground,

In tale and fable I outwit them all,
My bark is sharp, my step is small,
At dusk I slip through wood and street,
On velvet paws, my dinner to meet,

ciphers.hint: Night hunter hooting in hollow trees.
poem_stanzas:
A night-time hunter with a silent wing,
My hooting calls through darkness ring,
My eyes are lanterns wide and bright,
I see the mouse in dead of night,

By day I doze in hollow trees,
At dusk I wake upon the breeze,
They call me wise in tale and song,
My talons sharp, my flight is long,

ciphers.hint: Eight-legged weaver of silken traps.
poem_stanzas:
Eight legs and eight eyes weave my trap,
I spin my silk without a gap,
No wings have I, yet flies I catch,
My silver net no moth can match,

In dusty corners I make my home,
Across the ceiling I will roam,
I mend my web when winds have torn,
And feast before the early morn,

ciphers.hint: Ocean giant singing and spouting.
poem_stanzas:
I am the giant of the ocean deep,
I sing the songs that sailors keep,
I sieve the sea for tiny krill,
And spout my breath with hearty will,

No fish am I, though I swim the blue,
My newborn calves breathe air like you,
I breach the waves in leaping play,
And dive a mile beneath the day,

ciphers.hint: Black scolder that fashions tools.
poem_stanzas:
A black-clad scholar of the field,
I bend the wire, I solve, I steal,
My harsh voice scolds the morning air,
I gather shiny things with care,

They hang my straw twin in the corn,
Yet I return at early morn,
I learn each face and pay each debt,
I mourn my dead, I never forget,

ciphers.hint: Clicking keys beneath your typing hands.
poem_stanzas:
A field of keys beneath your hands,
I click and clack at your commands,
The space-bar thumps beneath your thumb,
The writer's rhythm, fast and numb,

The writer's hammer, the player's sword,
Shortcuts hide in every chord,
Wipe my crumbs and I will sing,
I am the piano of everything,

ciphers.hint: Porous cube drinking spills by the sink.
poem_stanzas:
I am the porous cube beside the sink,
I drink the spills faster than you blink,
Soft when wet and scratchy when dry,
I scrub the dishes piled high,

My wild kin live upon the ocean floor,
Filtering tides forevermore,
Squeeze me dry and I spring back,
A thirsty helper, never slack,

ciphers.hint: Wax pillar lit for birthdays and vigils.
poem_stanzas:
A waxen pillar with a dancing crown,
I shrink each hour as I drip down,
One breath of wind can end my life,
Yet I console the darkened night,

I mark the birthday wish, the dinner's glow,
With scented wax I drip and flow,
Blow me out and watch me smoke,
I am the darkness' brightest cloak,

ciphers.hint: Trembling needle always seeking north.
poem_stanzas:
A needle trembles in my round glass face,
Forever seeking the frozen place,
Sailors and hikers trust my art,
I never lie, I do my part,

Pair me with maps and you won't go wrong,
My wind-rose spins both short and long,
Hold me level, keep me still,
And I will guide you over the hill,

ciphers.hint: Iron grip holding ships in place.
poem_stanzas:
I am the iron that holds the ship,
My flukes grip sand with a steadfast grip,
Cast me down and the vessel stays,
Through rolling nights and windy days,

Heave me up when it's time to roam,
Sailors ink me far from home,
I steady giants in the gale,
The heavy hope that will not fail,

ciphers.hint: Runged rails for reaching rooftops.
poem_stanzas:
Two rails and rungs, I lean and wait,
I reach the rooftop, loft, and gate,
The painter climbs me with his pail,
The cat comes down with a piteous wail,

Fold me flat against the wall,
Extend me tall, I never fall,
Walk beneath me, so they say,
And seven years of luck you'll pay,

ciphers.hint: A sweet ache for what is far away.
poem_stanzas:
I am the ache for what is far,
A wish upon a falling star,
I stretch between the now and then,
And color every how and when,

The traveler feels me in the night,
A hunger with no feast in sight,
Part sweet, part sorrow, all unrest,
A guest that never leaves the breast,

ciphers.hint: Midnight knocker replaying past mistakes.
poem_stanzas:
I knock at midnight on your door,
Replaying what you said before,
The word you wish you could unsay,
Follows you into the day,

I am the backward-looking pain,
That falls like never-ending rain,
Learn from me and I grow light,
Feed me, and I haunt the night,

ciphers.hint: Wide-eyed awe at common things.
poem_stanzas:
I am the wideness in young eyes,
The gasp beneath the starry skies,
I turn the pebble to a prize,
And fill the small with grand surprise,

I sent the sailors past the chart,
I lift the curious mind to art,
I never kill, I only feed,
The question is my only seed,

ciphers.hint: Steady strength that faces down fear.
poem_stanzas:
I am the strength that faces fear,
I hold you steady when foes are near,
My knees may tremble, still I stay,
I choose the harder, kinder way,

The firefighter climbs, the witness stands,
I steady shaking, sweating hands,
I am not loud, I rarely boast,
I show up most when needed most,

ciphers.hint: Sheltered arms hugging the fleet.
poem_stanzas:
I am the arms that hug the fleet,
Where tired vessels find retreat,
Stone walls guard my quiet mouth,
From northern gale and restless south,

Cranes unload along my quay,
Gulls complain the livelong day,
Every voyage begins right here,
In sheltered water, calm and clear,

ciphers.hint: Grassy field blooming with wildflowers.
poem_stanzas:
An open field of grass and bloom,
Where bees and butterflies find room,
The scythe keeps me from turning wild,
I am the summer's carefree child,

I feed the herd, I hide the hare,
I scent the warm evening air,
Mow me late and I'll reseed,
And feed the winter's hungry need,

ciphers.hint: Creeping mile of ice grinding mountains.
poem_stanzas:
I am the flood that cannot flow,
A mile of ice that moves too slow,
I grind the mountains into flour,
A patient, crushing, frozen power,

My blue cracks yawn without a sound,
One step too far, you're never found,
I calve whole islands to the sea,
And carve the valleys wild and free,

ciphers.hint: Green palms and water in seas of sand.
poem_stanzas:
A green surprise in seas of sand,
Where palms and cool water stand,
The caravan forgets its thirst,
And camels drink their deepest first,

I am the traveler's answered prayer,
A shady rest beyond compare,
Mirages mock me all day long,
Yet here the wells are deep and strong,

ciphers.hint: Dancing orange light warming winter hands.
poem_stanzas:
I dance on logs in orange light,
I warm your hands on winter night,
One careless spark can summon me,
And cities fall before my spree,

Mankind first tamed me long ago,
Rub two dry sticks and I will show,
I cook your food, I forge your steel,
I make the engine's piston reel,

ciphers.hint: Golden crown dancing on the wick.
poem_stanzas:
I crown the wick, I kiss the air,
Blue at the root and gold above,
I shiver in the slightest draft,
Yet I can melt the steel in half,

The moth adores me to its cost,
Old papers in me have been lost,
I rise forever, point on high,
And vanish upward to the sky,

ciphers.hint: Icy ferns painting midnight windows.
poem_stanzas:
I paint the window white overnight,
I silver lawns by morning light,
I nip the pumpkin and the vine,
And etch the glass with stars in line,

The children know me as old Jack,
I glitter on the pumpkin's back,
I vanish with the climbing sun,
My crystal work is never done,

ciphers.hint: Ghostly breath fogging winter mirrors.
poem_stanzas:
I rise from kettles, thin and white,
I fog the mirror, blur the light,
Chill me down and I fall as dew,
I was the cloud before you knew,

Your winter breath is one of mine,
I veil the hills at morning time,
Invisible till I condense,
I am the water's thin disguise,

ciphers.hint: Riddling guardian with lion's paws.
poem_stanzas:
I guard the tombs with lion's paws,
A human face, a riddle's jaws,
I pose my question at the gate,
Answer, or meet a deadly fate,

What walks on four, then two, then three?
The Theban king once answered me,
He passed me by and I fell down,
My stone twin watches over town,

ciphers.hint: Deep terror said to drag down ships.
poem_stanzas:
They say my arms can snap the mast,
And drag tall ships down hard and fast,
The ocean boils where I awake,
And seasoned sailors sweat and shake,

Few have seen me, none can prove,
Yet still the sailor-tales all move,
I am the deep's most dreaded dream,
A hundred suckers strong, they deem,

ciphers.hint: Grove spirit dancing with fauns.
poem_stanzas:
A spirit of the wood and spring,
I join the faun's round dance and sing,
My sisters haunt the stream and tree,
Half shy, half wild, forever free,

The laurel hides one of my kin,
Who chose the bark to dwell within,
We fade when forests meet the axe,
And answer only nature's tracks,

ciphers.hint: Gentle west wind coaxing blossoms open.
poem_stanzas:
I am the west wind, soft and warm,
I never rage, I never harm,
I coax the blossoms to unfold,
And turn the winter's grey to gold,

The Greeks once gave me breath and fame,
Each spring returns me just the same,
Sailors bless me, seeds adore,
I knock upon the garden door,

ciphers.hint: Six strings strummed by the campfire.
poem_stanzas:
Six strings upon a wooden frame,
Frets that fingers learn to tame,
Strum me loudly, pluck me soft,
I sing both low and sweet aloft,

The campfire's friend, the stage's pride,
Lean me gently on your side,
My hollow body swells each note,
From concert hall to country road,

ciphers.hint: Silver pipe trilling above the orchestra.
poem_stanzas:
A silver pipe held to the side,
Blow across me, pure and wide,
My trill outruns the nightingale,
I soar where violins set sail,

I need no reeds, just breath and keys,
I dance above the orchestral seas,
The shepherd's pipe is kin to me,
I sing the pastoral, wild and free,

ciphers.hint: Story-song of shipwreck, love, and war.
poem_stanzas:
I am the story set to song,
Four lines a verse, I run quite long,
I tell of shipwreck, love, and war,
And every inn has heard before,

The minstrel carried me door to door,
My refrain begs you sing once more,
Folk singers keep me still alive,
In every verse the old tales thrive,

ciphers.hint: Kayak blade that also taps table-tennis balls.
poem_stanzas:
The kayaker's engine, light and long,
I dip each side, left then right,
I steer the rapids, calm or strong,
And skim the lake in morning light,

At table tennis I'm short and round,
I meet the ball with hollow sound,
One word for rapids and for play,
I serve you work and sport each day,

ciphers.hint: Four runners sharing one baton race.
poem_stanzas:
I am the race no runner runs alone,
Four runners share both sweat and crown,
A hollow stick must make the round,
Passed hand to hand, never touching ground,

Pass the stick inside the zone,
Drop it once and hopes are gone,
Swimmers tag the wall to send the next,
One team's rhythm beats the best,

ciphers.hint: The bony helmet that houses the mind.
poem_stanzas:
A bony dome that crowns the frame,
A hollow hall where thoughts take flame,
Two empty windows, dark and deep,
Look out on worlds you wake from sleep.

Beneath a grin that never ends,
The seat of judgment and of friends,
I guard the softest thing you own,
Then stand alone when flesh is gone.

ciphers.hint: The bony column that keeps you upright.
poem_stanzas:
A ladder of bone behind the skin,
A hundred joints that hold you in,
I curve and bend, yet never break,
And carry weight for walking's sake.

From base of neck to tail I run,
A column built of one by one,
Quick nerves branch out on either side,
The body's highway, long and wide.

ciphers.hint: The joint midway down your arm.
poem_stanzas:
A hinge between two lengths of bone,
I let you reach what stands alone,
I'm where the arm can fold and bend,
And where a tingling jolt can send.

A pointy knob of joint and skin,
The place your sleeve begins to thin,
I'll nudge a friend to draw their eye,
Or rest upon a counter high.

ciphers.hint: One of the ten that help you grasp.
poem_stanzas:
Five slender friends upon a palm,
Each small and quick and mostly calm,
I point, I tap, I pinch, I hold,
I trace the stories pages told.

I end with nail and whorled design,
For typing, tying, threading twine,
Without a ring you feel bereft,
Count what remains when one has left.

ciphers.hint: The fleshy engine that moves your bones.
poem_stanzas:
I bunch and shorten, pull and strain,
Then lengthen out and rest again,
A red rope bound to bone by white,
I make the still frame come to life.

Flex me and see a rounded hill,
I ache when worked and grow when still,
The heart is one that never tires,
The fist is one of many spires.

ciphers.hint: The body's chemical factory under the ribs.
poem_stanzas:
The largest gland the body keeps,
I filter what the bloodstream sweeps,
I make the bile that breaks the fat,
And store the sugar, just like that.

Beneath the ribs upon the right,
I work in silence through the night,
The butcher knows me rich and brown,
And too much drink can wear me down.

ciphers.hint: One of the paired organs that clean your blood.
poem_stanzas:
A bean-shaped filter, paired and small,
I sort the blood and take the fall,
I keep the salt and water right,
And send the waste away by night.

Two of me sit against the back,
Each doing more than most would guess,
The stone that forms within my cup
Will make a person wince and press.

ciphers.hint: The passage at the front of your neck.
poem_stanzas:
The tunnel where the breath goes through,
And where the swallowed food slips too,
I hoard the words before they're said,
And parch when fever fills the head.

A lump can rise with grief and fear,
A song is wrung from somewhere near,
I'm wrapped in glands and ringed with bone,
The gateway every voice has known.

ciphers.hint: The joint where the arm meets the hand.
poem_stanzas:
A narrow gate of many small bones,
Where all the hand's quick fingers connect,
I turn, I twist, I flick, I wave,
And tell the time upon my band.

The pulse is counted on my side,
The cuff of shirts will often hide,
I'm where the arm gives way to hand,
A hinge of many, small and grand.

ciphers.hint: The joint between your leg and foot.
poem_stanzas:
A joint above the heel and sole,
That takes the weight and keeps you whole,
I bend when stairs and hills appear,
And swell when twisted, sharp and clear.

Two bony knobs on either side,
Where straps and laces both abide,
I let the foot point down and up,
And punish those who trip or slip.

ciphers.hint: A towering rise of rock and snow.
poem_stanzas:
I wear a crown of snow and stone,
A giant that the clouds have known,
My shoulders hold the eagles high,
My feet are where the valleys lie.

I took ten million years to grow,
I cradle springs and send them low,
A peak so tall the air grows thin,
The daring few who climb my skin.

ciphers.hint: A colored arc that follows a storm.
poem_stanzas:
I arc across a dripping sky,
A colored bridge that none can climb,
I need the rain and sun together,
And vanish when the weather's fine.

Seven bands from red to blue,
I bend the light and split it through,
A pot of gold is said to wait
Where I touch ground, but not of late.

ciphers.hint: A soft and gentle moving air.
poem_stanzas:
A gentle hand that has no form,
That bends the grass and lifts the corn,
I cool the brow on summer days,
And push the sails on watery ways.

Too soft to see, too light to hold,
I ruffle hair and carry cold,
I bring the scents from field and sea,
And stir the leaves on every tree.

ciphers.hint: A low, clinging veil of water droplets.
poem_stanzas:
A ghost of water, cool and grey,
That blurs the hills and hides the way,
I cling to lakes at break of dawn,
Then leave when morning's heat is born.

I pad the valley, damp and deep,
I rouse the sleeper half from sleep,
My fingers curl around the street,
And make the known world incomplete.

ciphers.hint: A drifting mass of vapor in the sky.
poem_stanzas:
A floating flock of white and grey,
That sails the sky and drifts away,
I'm born of vapor from the sea,
And heavier than ships, though free.

I shade the field on summer noon,
I hide the moon and smother June,
When I grow dark and full and low,
The rain will fall, the wind will blow.

ciphers.hint: A steep face of rock above the sea.
poem_stanzas:
A wall of stone that meets the sky,
Where gulls and hardy sea-pinks lie,
My face is sheer, my base is foam,
The waves must gnaw me if they'd roam.

I drop from heath to churning tide,
No gentle slope on either side,
The climber finds me cold and steep,
And sailors dread me, dark and deep.

ciphers.hint: A large body of still fresh water.
poem_stanzas:
A mirror set within the land,
That holds the clouds and hills at hand,
I have no current, yet I breathe,
And freeze and thaw and softly seethe.

The rivers fill me, slow and sure,
And I am calm and wide and pure,
The fish and reeds and boat belong
To me, the shelter of the song.

ciphers.hint: A small, flowing course of water.
poem_stanzas:
A ribbon winding through the trees,
That talks to stones and bends with ease,
I start as rain on high steep ground,
And hurry seaward, never bound.

I tumble over rock and root,
And carve a path for trout and newt,
The miller turned my strength to bread,
The thirsty cattle know my bed.

ciphers.hint: The flower of a tree, brief and fragrant.
poem_stanzas:
A brief and fragrant burst of white,
That clothes the bough in early light,
I come before the fruit is born,
And fall when spring is nearly worn.

The bee and I are old allies,
I ring the branch with bright replies,
The wind will take me, petal by petal,
And strew the earth where lovers settle.

ciphers.hint: A light, flat plume from a bird.
poem_stanzas:
A quill of air, a weightless thing,
That birds arrange to fly and preen,
I keep them warm, I steer their path,
And drift to earth when they have been.

A plume of barbs on either side,
That lifts a creature up to glide,
I'm gathered where a bird has passed,
Or worn in hats of dandies past.

ciphers.hint: An instrument that magnifies the distant sky.
poem_stanzas:
A long brass eye that points at night,
I gather what is far and slight,
Two lenses bend a distant ray,
And bring the heavens to where you stay.

Upon a mountain, calm and high,
I read the darkness of the sky,
The moons and rings and seas of stone
Are mine to find, and mine alone.

ciphers.hint: A vehicle that thrusts itself into space.
poem_stanzas:
A tower of fire that leaves the ground,
With thunder for its only sound,
I ride a pillar, white and hot,
And climb where birds and clouds cannot.

I shed my skins as I ascend,
And burn the fuel to the end,
Then drop my stages, spent and bare,
To punch a hole in empty air.

ciphers.hint: A rocky wanderer among the planets.
poem_stanzas:
A lump of stone without a home,
Through black and empty dark I roam,
Too small to glow, too large to fall,
A wandering rock beyond recall.

I drift in belts where planets fail,
A chip of world, a broken scale,
If earth should cross my silent track,
I'd leave a scar and not look back.

ciphers.hint: The line where land or sea meets the sky.
poem_stanzas:
The seam between the earth and sky,
Where far things vanish from the eye,
I stretch from every side the same,
And shift as you shift, never tame.

The sailor steers by where I lie,
The sun goes down and climbs so high,
I'm always distant, always near,
The farthest edge the eye can clear.

ciphers.hint: The point of the sky directly overhead.
poem_stanzas:
The highest point a star can climb,
The summit of the sky and time,
Straight overhead, the top of all,
From which the bright ones start to fall.

A gnomon's shadow marks me true,
The noonday sun hangs straight and new,
Below me lies the lowest deep,
The opposite where dreamers sleep.

ciphers.hint: When the sun reaches its farthest north or south.
poem_stanzas:
I come but twice in every year,
The longest day, the shortest here,
The sun stands still upon his track,
Then turns and slowly gives it back.

A tilt of earth decides my date,
When light and darkness celebrate,
The reapers know me, and the frost,
When one extreme of day is lost.

ciphers.hint: The shimmering lights of the polar sky.
poem_stanzas:
A curtain woven in the cold,
A dance of green and pink and gold,
I hang above the polar snow,
And ripple as the solar winds blow.

The ancients feared my wavering light,
A fire that marched across the night,
The charged wind strikes the upper air,
And paints my ribbons, bright and rare.

ciphers.hint: The bowl-shaped scar left by a falling rock.
poem_stanzas:
A bowl that nothing ever fills,
That scars the moon and rocky hills,
An impact dug me long ago,
When fire and stone came down below.

I'm round with rim and shadowed floor,
A cup upon a dusty shore,
The wandering rock that made me deep
Left silence where I hold my sleep.

ciphers.hint: The sweet white grain in bowl and cup.
poem_stanzas:
A heap of white from cane or beet,
The thing that makes a sour thing sweet,
I vanish into tea and cake,
And send the tooth a toothache's ache.

Dissolve me, and the water hides,
The simple taste that it abides,
A pyramid in ancient bowls,
I feed the craving and the holes.

ciphers.hint: A sour yellow citrus fruit.
poem_stanzas:
A sun of orchards, tart and bright,
I pucker lips and sting the sight,
My rind is laced with fragrant oil,
My juice has saved a sailor's toil.

When life gives you my yellow twin,
You make a drink and force a grin,
Squeezed for a drop, or cut in slices,
I'm sour enough to cure the ices.

ciphers.hint: A long, curved yellow fruit in a peel.
poem_stanzas:
A yellow crescent, curved and long,
That comes in bunches, firm and strong,
I wear a coat you peel away,
And soften brown as I decay.

I grow in heat and hang in hands,
The ape and monkey know my lands,
I'm peeled and eaten, sliced on bread,
Or fried as fritters, hot and spread.

ciphers.hint: A small round fruit that grows in a cluster.
poem_stanzas:
A jewel round in clustered rows,
From green to purple, each one grows,
I'm plucked in bunches from the vine,
And crushed to make a crimson wine.

The Romans pressed me underfoot,
The child eats me and spits the pit,
Dried, I become a wrinkled treat,
For ancient feasts and journeys sweet.

ciphers.hint: A small bitter fruit pressed for its oil.
poem_stanzas:
A small green orb upon a bough,
That turns to black as time allows,
My flesh is bitter, brined to please,
My oil has lit a thousand seas.

A branch of me means peace to some,
In wooden bowls of Greece I come,
The press that squeezes me is old,
And bottles me in green and gold.

ciphers.hint: A long orange root that you eat.
poem_stanzas:
An orange spike that hides in earth,
A tapering root of modest worth,
The rabbit gnaws me off at dawn,
The cook will scrape me, cold and wan.

A feathery green crowns where I grew,
They say I sharpen how you view,
Boiled soft in soup or raw and snapped,
I'm sweet and common, never crabbed.

ciphers.hint: A strong-smelling bulb used in cooking.
poem_stanzas:
A papery bulb of many moons,
Whose bite can drive a crowd from rooms,
I keep the vampire and the cold
At bay, or so the stories told.

A clove of me in olive oil
Will make the kitchen's scent recoil,
I braid in strings to hang and dry,
And season stews as weeks go by.

ciphers.hint: A sweet brown treat made from cocoa beans.
poem_stanzas:
A brown delight from tiny beans,
That grows beneath tropical greens,
The Aztec drank me, bitter, hot,
And swore a treasure had been got.

A gentle melt upon the tongue,
A comfort for both old and young,
I come in bars and eggs and coins,
Where longing and my sweetness join.

ciphers.hint: The huge grey beast with a trunk.
poem_stanzas:
A mountain walking on four logs,
With flapping ears and ivory prongs,
A nose that's also hand and hose,
I trumpet where the river goes.

They say I never quite forget,
The driest season's not begun yet,
I'm largest of the beasts on land,
And gentle when I reach a hand.

ciphers.hint: A flightless bird in a black-and-white coat.
poem_stanzas:
A bird in evening dress and bow,
Who cannot fly, yet swims below,
I waddle upon ice and stone,
And warm my egg upon my own.

Black of coat and white of vest,
I huddle close to warm the rest,
The southern ice and southern sea,
Are all the world that's known to me.

ciphers.hint: A slow reptile that carries its shell.
poem_stanzas:
A house that walks and carries me,
A hardened dome of history,
I plod where neither haste nor dread
Can hurry my deliberate tread.

If danger comes, I pull my head
Inside my roof and lie as dead,
The sea or garden knows me well,
The slow one in a bony shell.

ciphers.hint: A clever climbing animal with a tail.
poem_stanzas:
A tumbler in the leafy height,
With human hands and tail of light,
I swing from branch to branch and screech,
And steal the fruit just out of reach.

I copy what I see you do,
And crack a nut and leap anew,
The jungle and the zoo both hold
My busy, restless family fold.

ciphers.hint: A swift bird of prey that dives.
poem_stanzas:
A hunter of the open air,
With pointed wings and stooping stare,
I hover, then I fold and dive,
And strike the field where prey's alive.

The keeper's whistle calls me home,
Across the dusk on silent loam,
A prince once carried me to chase,
The fleetest bird of any place.

ciphers.hint: A rodent that builds dams in streams.
poem_stanzas:
An engineer with chisel teeth,
I fell the tree and strip the leaf,
I build a wall across the stream,
And make a pond of my own dream.

My tail is flat, my fur is dense,
I slap the water in defense,
The lodge of mud and stick and stone,
Is warm and dry, and all my own.

ciphers.hint: A colorful insect with four wings.
poem_stanzas:
A flying flower, a painted pair,
That flutters on the summer air,
I started life as slow and small,
Then wove a sleep inside a wall.

I sipped from blooms on slender things,
I am the summer made of wings,
The child who chases me will find,
I'm hard to hold and hard to mind.

ciphers.hint: A large predatory fish of the sea.
poem_stanzas:
A grey torpedo of the deep,
That wakes the shallows from their sleep,
A fin that cuts the surface glass,
A shadow where the swimmers pass.

My rows of teeth are always new,
I follow where the currents drew,
The blood of oceans is my claim,
And those who fear me dread my name.

ciphers.hint: A writing tool made of graphite and wood.
poem_stanzas:
A slender rod with a blackened core,
That marks the page and then wants more,
I have no ink, yet leave a line,
And shave myself to keep it fine.

A rubber crown can rub me out,
A point that dulls with use, no doubt,
The writer holds me, thinking hard,
And leaves me chewed and cropped and scarred.

ciphers.hint: A cutting tool with two pivoting blades.
poem_stanzas:
Two blades that kiss and then divide,
A pair of legs that open wide,
I walk in cuts along the line,
And part the cloth as if by sign.

I'm used by tailor, cook, and child,
For paper, ribbon, thread, and wild,
My handles fit two thumbs, two rings,
And I can snip most anything.

ciphers.hint: A portable shelter from the rain.
poem_stanzas:
A mushroom that I hold in rain,
That opens wide above the lane,
A ring of ribs around a pole,
I keep the weather from your soul.

A handle hooked for arm and hand,
I bloom when clouds take over land,
Forgotten on a train or bus,
I live to keep the drizzle off us.

ciphers.hint: A utensil with a small bowl for eating.
poem_stanzas:
A little shovel for the soup,
A shallow bowl upon a loop,
I lift the pea, I carry stew,
And ferry warmth from bowl to you.

Silver or steel or wooden ware,
I nest in drawers and tables share,
The baby bangs me, the elder sips,
And I deliver to the lips.

ciphers.hint: A hollow metal object that rings.
poem_stanzas:
A metal throat that sings when struck,
A clapper swings with ringing luck,
I call the village, mark the hour,
And joy or mourning is my power.

In towers high and sleighs and schools,
The rope and I are simple tools,
I'm hung to summon, warn, and tell,
The loud-mouthed hollow in a shell.

ciphers.hint: A small folding case for money and cards.
poem_stanzas:
A folded home for cards and cash,
That lives inside a pocket's gash,
I fatten when the month is new,
And flatten when the bills fall due.

A cowhide case with stitched seams,
I guard the things of paper dreams,
A thief may lift me on the street,
And leave you poor and incomplete.

ciphers.hint: A pair of lenses worn to see clearly.
poem_stanzas:
Two windows joined across a nose,
That sharpen what the weary knows,
I rest on ears with slender arms,
And mend the world of distant charms.

Without me, words will blur and swim,
The far horizon grows too dim,
The thin and framed and tinted kind,
Can change the way the world's defined.

ciphers.hint: A jeweled headpiece worn by a monarch.
poem_stanzas:
A golden ring of jeweled points,
That rests where royal brow anoints,
I mark the head that wears the weight,
Of all the burden of the state.

Of gold and gems and iron bands,
I pass from dying to new hands,
The thorns once pressed upon a brow,
Became this circle, worn even now.

ciphers.hint: A feeling of great pleasure or joy.
poem_stanzas:
A sudden lift, a spark, a glow,
That makes the heart forget its woe,
I come on wings when nothing's planned,
And leave a warmth upon the hand.

A child's first snow, a lover's glance,
A friend's return, a sudden dance,
I'm brief and bright, a bubble's rise,
That lights the cheek and fills the eyes.

ciphers.hint: The bitter wish for what another has.
poem_stanzas:
A green-eyed ache that will not sleep,
That counts the gifts another keeps,
I sour the feast, I dim the prize,
And grow the more I fix my eyes.

I dress in praise and call it fair,
Yet gnaw the bone and tear the hair,
The neighbor's field is always green,
To me, who wants what I have seen.

ciphers.hint: Deep sorrow caused by a loss.
poem_stanzas:
A heavy stone that sits and stays,
That muffles all the brightened days,
I come when love has gone away,
And color everything in gray.

I live in songs and empty chairs,
In folded clothes and muted prayers,
The tear that will not be denied,
The hollow where a person died.

ciphers.hint: The heavy feeling of having done wrong.
poem_stanzas:
A weight that follows where you go,
A scratching voice you've come to know,
I keep the ledger of your wrongs,
And set them to their endless songs.

I wake you in the darkest hour,
And strip the sleep of all its power,
A look you gave, a word you said,
Comes back to haunt you in your bed.

ciphers.hint: A painful feeling of embarrassment or dishonor.
poem_stanzas:
A blush that spreads without a cause,
A mirror held to all your flaws,
I make you small, I make you hide,
And burn the cheeks with fire inside.

I'm worn like clothing, hot and tight,
I turn the day into the night,
The head that drops, the eyes that fall,
The voice that will not speak at all.

ciphers.hint: A state of perfect happiness.
poem_stanzas:
A perfect hush, a sunlit hour,
A garden hidden in a flower,
I need no reason, ask no why,
I am the blue that fills the sky.

I'm found in silence and in song,
Where nothing in the world is wrong,
The lovers know me on the grass,
The saints have seen me as they pass.

ciphers.hint: The complete loss of hope.
poem_stanzas:
The bottom of the well of night,
Where even love has lost its light,
I whisper that it's not worth trying,
And seat myself beside the dying.

I'm last to leave, I'm first to call,
I build a wall and then a wall,
The hope you had, I take in hand,
And bury it beneath the sand.

ciphers.hint: Compassion shown to someone in your power.
poem_stanzas:
The hand that stays the punishing blow,
The pity spared to friend and foe,
I'm asked for on the scaffold stair,
And granted where there's love to spare.

I'm not what's fair, I'm what is kind,
The quarter given by the mind,
The judge who sets the prisoner free,
And hears the better angels' plea.

ciphers.hint: A broad, flat area of raised land.
poem_stanzas:
A table made of stone and soil,
A lifted plain without a toil,
I rise above the lower ground,
And stretch for miles without a sound.

The herders bring their flocks to me,
Where air is thin and grass is free,
An escarpment marks my edge and wall,
And I am flat, and I am tall.

ciphers.hint: Land jutting into water, joined at one end.
poem_stanzas:
A finger of the land that goes,
Into the sea where water flows,
I'm wrapped by waves on either hand,
And join the mainland by a band.

The sailor rounds my rocky end,
The map will show me as a bend,
Three sides are ocean, one is earth,
A narrow neck that gave me birth.

ciphers.hint: A shallow stretch of water cut off from the sea.
poem_stanzas:
A shallow bath beside the sea,
That keeps the waves away from me,
A ring of coral or of sand,
Holds water in and holds the land.

I'm calm and green and warm and still,
The crabs and fish obey my will,
Between the reef and shore I lie,
A sheltered cradle, blue and shy.

ciphers.hint: A ridge of coral near the ocean surface.
poem_stanzas:
A city built by tiny hands,
That grows in warm and shallow sands,
A ridge that ships must steer around,
Where life in colors can be found.

I'm white when bleached and bright when well,
A thousand creatures in a shell,
The coral makes me, bone by bone,
And I am beautiful and stone.

ciphers.hint: A marshy area of soft, wet ground.
poem_stanzas:
A soggy wood of root and mud,
Where water stands and will not flood,
The cypress and the frog are mine,
And everything that loves the slime.

I'm green and rank and hard to cross,
The lantern light will dance and toss,
The traveler learns to watch his feet,
Where water and the dry land meet.

ciphers.hint: A vast, treeless plain of the far north.
poem_stanzas:
A treeless plain of frozen ground,
Where little more than moss is found,
The winter holds me half the year,
And frozen earth lies always near.

The caribou will cross my waste,
The midnight sun will see me graced,
Too cold for trees, too far for most,
The northern edge, the silent coast.

ciphers.hint: A wide, flat grassland of North America.
poem_stanzas:
A sea of grass that has no end,
Where wind and wheat together bend,
The bison thundered where I lay,
Before the plow took them away.

I'm flat and wide and rich and brown,
The settler built his sod-house town,
The clouds will stack above my floor,
And far away a train will roar.

ciphers.hint: A hot spring that shoots water into the air.
poem_stanzas:
A kettle buried underground,
That builds its steam without a sound,
Then hurls a column to the sky,
And drops it down when it runs dry.

I'm timed like clockwork, hot and white,
A tower born of earth and light,
The mineral crust around my vent,
Shows where my fury has been spent.

ciphers.hint: A group of atoms bonded together.
poem_stanzas:
A cluster bound by hidden ties,
Too small for any of your eyes,
Two atoms join, or three, or more,
And I am what they're gathered for.

The water and the air are made,
Of countless me in quiet parade,
The chemist draws me as a ball,
With sticks that hold and join us all.

ciphers.hint: A tiny negatively charged particle in an atom.
poem_stanzas:
A speck of charge too small to see,
That orbits like a buzzing bee,
I carry current through the wire,
And make the lightning and the fire.

I'm negative and always fleet,
I make the atom stay complete,
The television and the brain,
Both send me dancing down a lane.

ciphers.hint: The resistance when two surfaces rub together.
poem_stanzas:
A stubborn drag that slows the slide,
When two rough surfaces collide,
I turn the motion into heat,
And make the tire grip the street.

Without me, knots would not hold tight,
And walking would be one long flight,
I'm why the brakes can stop the car,
And why the sled will not go far.

ciphers.hint: A narrow, intense beam of coherent light.
poem_stanzas:
A pencil made of single light,
That cuts through steel and through the night,
One color only, straight and thin,
I point where surgeons let me in.

The mirrors make my beam grow strong,
One wavelength marching all along,
I read the disc, I scan the bar,
And measure distance near and far.

ciphers.hint: A glass shape that splits white light into colors.
poem_stanzas:
A wedge of glass that bends the ray,
And turns the white to colored day,
I break the beam into a band,
That spills like paint across the hand.

The rainbow in the sky is kin,
Though water makes that one begin,
The physicist will point me true,
And show the spectrum's every hue.

ciphers.hint: A metal made by mixing two or more metals.
poem_stanzas:
A marriage made of metals two,
That gives the world a stronger hue,
I'm bronze and steel and brass and gold,
More useful than the parts I hold.

The smith will melt and pour and cool,
And I come out a better tool,
A little tin will toughen me,
A little chrome will set me free.

ciphers.hint: A hot, ionized state of matter.
poem_stanzas:
A gas so hot it comes apart,
And loses charges at the start,
The fourth estate of matter's reign,
That fills the stars and neon lane.

The lightning and the sun are made,
Of me, in glowing streams displayed,
The screen and the reactor know,
The state where charged particles go.

ciphers.hint: The smallest living unit of an organism.
poem_stanzas:
A tiny room with walls and door,
The smallest living unit, nothing more,
I hold a nucleus within,
And start the life that will begin.

The body builds me by the million,
In every tissue, every region,
The prisoner's and the battery's name,
Are also mine, in different frame.

ciphers.hint: A creature half human and half horse.
poem_stanzas:
Above the waist a man and mind,
Below, four hooves of horse and hind,
I gallop through the Grecian tale,
With bow and wisdom, strong and hale.

The teacher of the heroes, wise,
I watched the young Achilles rise,
Half beast, half man, I split the line,
And in the stars I still can shine.

ciphers.hint: The bull-headed monster of the Cretan maze.
poem_stanzas:
A bull's head on a man's strong frame,
A monster born of royal shame,
The maze was built to hold me in,
Where none could find me, none could win.

I ate the tribute sent each year,
And fed the labyrinth with fear,
A thread of string undid my reign,
And left me silent, huge, and slain.

ciphers.hint: A mythical beast with an eagle's head and a lion's body.
poem_stanzas:
An eagle's head and wings of gold,
A lion's body, proud and bold,
I guard the treasure and the grave,
The bravest of the beasts, and brave.

I pull the chariot of the sun,
I'm heraldry for everyone,
The north and south in one design,
The sky and earth in single line.

ciphers.hint: A mythical horse with a single horn.
poem_stanzas:
A silver horse of gentle grace,
With one long horn upon the face,
I'm shy and wild and hard to find,
And only pure hearts tame my kind.

The lion and I once had a fight,
The hunter seeks me day and night,
My horn is said to heal and cure,
And make the poisoned water pure.

ciphers.hint: A mythical sea creature, half woman and half fish.
poem_stanzas:
Above the waves a woman sings,
Below, a tail with silver rings,
I comb my hair upon a stone,
And lure the sailors from their own.

The sea is both my home and dress,
I mourn the air I cannot bless,
The fisher tells of me with dread,
And finds the rocks where sailors bled.

ciphers.hint: A many-headed serpent that regrows each lost head.
poem_stanzas:
A swamp-born serpent, many-tongued,
Whose heads return when they are stung,
For every neck a hero cut,
Two more would rise to join the knot.

Beneath the water, in the fen,
I grow my heads again, again,
The only way to end my reign,
Was fire, and a stone, and pain.

ciphers.hint: A small, mischievous fantasy creature.
poem_stanzas:
A small, sly thing of green and gray,
That haunts the cellar and the hay,
I steal the socks and spill the milk,
And creep about in stolen silk.

The nursery warns of me at night,
I pinch and laugh and hide from light,
Mischief is my only trade,
And children fear the noise I've made.

ciphers.hint: An object believed to bring good luck and protection.
poem_stanzas:
A stone or coin you keep and wear,
That guards you from the lurking snare,
A mark to turn a bullet's flight,
And bring you safety through the night.

Belief has made me strong and old,
I'm worn in silver, set in gold,
The soldier and the gambler trust,
My little weight to keep them just.

ciphers.hint: A brass instrument with a bright, powerful sound.
poem_stanzas:
A coiled brass throat that flares and rings,
The loudest of the silver things,
Three valves I press, a breath I take,
And armies rise and sleepers wake.

From jazz and marching band and hall,
I summon and I lead them all,
The herald and the solo star,
With bell that shines both near and far.

ciphers.hint: A stringed instrument played by plucking.
poem_stanzas:
A frame of wood with strings of wire,
That angels strum and poets admire,
I'm plucked by fingers, not by bow,
And ripple where the soft notes go.
